words.sanskrit: om apo va idam asan

meaning.en: in the beginning this was water
meaning.hi: आरम्भ में यह जल था

words.sanskrit: sa prajapatir ekah pushkara-parne samabhavat

meaning.en: the one lord of creatures arose on a lotus leaf
meaning.hi: प्रजापति एक कमल-पत्ते पर उत्पन्न हुए

words.sanskrit: tasya antar manasi kamah samavartata idam srijeyam iti

meaning.en: within his mind a wish arose: let me create this
meaning.hi: उसके मन में इच्छा जगी: मैं यह रचूँ

words.sanskrit: yat purusho manasa abhigacchati tad vacha vadati tat karmana karoti

meaning.en: what a person reaches in mind, they speak, then they do
meaning.hi: व्यक्ति मन से जो पाता है, वह बोलता है, फिर करता है

words.sanskrit: kamas tad agre samavartata

meaning.en: desire arose first of all
meaning.hi: इच्छा सबसे पहले उत्पन्न हुई

words.sanskrit: adhi manaso retah prathamam yad asit

meaning.en: the first seed that arose from mind
meaning.hi: मन से उपजा पहला बीज

words.sanskrit: sato bandhum asati nir avindan hridi pratishya kavayo manisha

meaning.en: sages found the bond of being in non-being, searching the heart
meaning.hi: ऋषियों ने हृदय में खोजकर सत् का बन्धन असत् में पाया

words.sanskrit: sa tapo 'tapyata sa tapas taptva sa etam mantra-rajam narasimham anushtubham apashyat

meaning.en: he performed austerity and saw the king of mantras, Narasimha in anushtubh
meaning.hi: उसने तप किया और नरसिंह अनुष्टुभ मन्त्रराज देखा

words.sanskrit: tenaiva sarvam idam asrijat

meaning.en: with that he created all this
meaning.hi: उसी से उसने यह सब रचा

words.sanskrit: anushtubho va imani bhutani jayante

meaning.en: these beings are born from anushtubh
meaning.hi: ये प्राणी अनुष्टुभ से जन्मते हैं

words.sanskrit: vag va anushtup

meaning.en: anushtubh indeed is speech
meaning.hi: अनुष्टुभ वाणी ही है

words.sanskrit: sasagaram saparvatam saptadvipam vasundharam tat samnah prathamam padam janiyat

meaning.en: the earth with oceans, mountains, seven isles, is its first quarter
meaning.hi: सागर, पर्वत, सप्तद्वीप सहित पृथ्वी इसका पहला चरण है

words.sanskrit: yaksha-gandharva-apsaro-gana-sevitam antariksham tat samno dvitiyam padam

meaning.en: the atmosphere served by celestial beings is its second quarter
meaning.hi: यक्ष-गन्धर्व-अप्सराओं से सेवित अन्तरिक्ष इसका दूसरा चरण है

words.sanskrit: sarvair devaih sevitam divam tat samnas tritiyam padam

meaning.en: heaven served by all gods is its third quarter
meaning.hi: सब देवों से सेवित स्वर्ग इसका तीसरा चरण है

words.sanskrit: brahma-svarupam nirañjanam paramavyomnikam tat samnash chaturtham padam

meaning.en: the pure form of Brahman, the highest realm, is its fourth quarter
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म-स्वरूप, निरंजन, परम व्योम इसका चौथा चरण है

words.sanskrit: yo janite so 'mritatvam cha gacchati

meaning.en: whoever knows this attains immortality
meaning.hi: जो जानता है वह अमरत्व पाता है

words.sanskrit: savitryasya ashtaksharam padam shriya abhishiktam tat samno 'ngam veda

meaning.en: the eight-syllable Savitri phrase crowned with fortune is a limb
meaning.hi: सावित्री का आठ-अक्षर पद, सम्पदा से मण्डित, एक अंग है

words.sanskrit: pranavam tat samno 'ngam veda sa trin lokan jayati

meaning.en: knowing Om as a limb, one conquers the three worlds
meaning.hi: ॐ को अंग जानकर, तीनों लोक जीतता है

words.sanskrit: chatur-vimshaty-aksharaa maha-lakshmir yajus tat samno 'ngam veda

meaning.en: the twenty-four syllable Mahalakshmi hymn is a limb
meaning.hi: चौबीस-अक्षर महालक्ष्मी स्तुति एक अंग है

words.sanskrit: stri-shudraya na icchanti

meaning.en: they do not wish it given to woman or shudra
meaning.hi: वे इसे स्त्री-शूद्र को देना नहीं चाहते

words.sanskrit: tasmat sarvada na achashte

meaning.en: therefore one should never speak it carelessly
meaning.hi: इसलिए इसे कभी लापरवाही से न बोले

words.sanskrit: agnir vai devah idam sarvam vishva bhutani pranah

meaning.en: fire is all the gods, this all, all beings, all breaths
meaning.hi: अग्नि सब देवता, यह सब, सब प्राणी, सब प्राण है

words.sanskrit: rig-yajuh-sama-atharva-rupah suryo hiranmayah purushah tat samno dvitiyam padam

meaning.en: the golden Person in the sun, made of the four Vedas, is the second quarter
meaning.hi: चार वेदों से बना, सूर्य में स्वर्णिम पुरुष, दूसरा चरण है

words.sanskrit: sa brahma sa shivah sa harih sendrah so 'ksharah paramah svarat

meaning.en: he is Brahma, Shiva, Vishnu, Indra, the imperishable supreme ruler
meaning.hi: वह ब्रह्मा, शिव, विष्णु, इन्द्र, अक्षर, परम शासक है

words.sanskrit: ugram prathamasya adyam jvalam dvitiyasya adyam nrisimham tritiyasya adyam mrityum chaturthasya adyam

meaning.en: fierce is the first syllable, blazing the second, man-lion the third, death the fourth
meaning.hi: उग्र पहला, ज्वलन्त दूसरा, नृसिंह तीसरा, मृत्यु चौथा आद्य अक्षर है

words.sanskrit: kshiroda-arnava-shayinam nri-kesari-vigraham yogi-dhyeyam param padam

meaning.en: reclining on the ocean of milk, man-lion form, the yogi's object of meditation, highest state
meaning.hi: क्षीर-सागर पर शायी, नृ-केसरी रूप, योगियों का ध्यान, परम पद

words.sanskrit: viram prathamasya adya-ardha-antyam tam dvitiyasya adya-ardha-antyam

meaning.en: vi from the first section's end, ram from the second's end
meaning.hi: पहले खण्ड के अन्त से वी, दूसरे के अन्त से राम

words.sanskrit: tena eva shariren samsaran muchyate muchayati

meaning.en: through this, one is freed from rebirth in this very body, and frees others
meaning.hi: इससे इसी शरीर में संसार से मुक्त होता है, और मुक्त करता है

words.sanskrit: tasmad idam eva mukhya-dvaram kalau na anyesham bhavati

meaning.en: this is the principal gateway in this age, there is none other
meaning.hi: यही इस युग में प्रमुख द्वार है, कोई और नहीं

words.sanskrit: ritam satyam param brahma purusham krishna-pingalam

meaning.en: cosmic order, truth, highest reality, dark-tawny Person
meaning.hi: ऋत, सत्य, परम ब्रह्म, श्याम-भूरा पुरुष

words.sanskrit: urdhva-retam virupaksham shankaram nila-lohitam

meaning.en: upward energy, uneven-eyed, auspicious, blue-red
meaning.hi: ऊर्ध्वरेत, विरूपाक्ष, शंकर, नीललोहित

words.sanskrit: umapatih pashupatih pinaki amita-dyutih

meaning.en: husband of Uma, lord of creatures, trident-bearer, boundless radiance
meaning.hi: उमापति, पशुपति, पिनाकी, अमित द्युति

words.sanskrit: ishanah sarva-vidyanam ishvarah sarva-bhutanam brahma-adhipatih

meaning.en: ruler of all learning, lord of all beings, master of Brahma
meaning.hi: सर्व-विद्याओं का ईशान, सर्व-भूतों का ईश्वर, ब्रह्माधिपति

words.sanskrit: yo vai yajur-veda-vachyah tam samam janiyat

meaning.en: he who is expressed by the Yajurveda, one should know as the formula
meaning.hi: जो यजुर्वेद द्वारा कहा गया, उसे सूत्र जानो

words.sanskrit: tad etat sachchidanandamayam param brahma

meaning.en: this is made of truth, consciousness, bliss, the highest reality
meaning.hi: यह सच्चिदानन्दमय परम ब्रह्म है

words.sanskrit: tam evam vidvan amrita iha bhavati

meaning.en: one who knows this becomes immortal here
meaning.hi: इसे जानने वाला यहीं अमर हो जाता है

words.sanskrit: vishva-srijah etena vai vishvam idam asrijanta

meaning.en: the creators of the universe created this universe with this
meaning.hi: विश्व-सृजकों ने इसी से यह विश्व रचा

words.sanskrit: brahmanah sa-lokatam sa-arshtitam sayujyam yanti

meaning.en: they attain the same world, standing, and union with Brahman
meaning.hi: वे ब्रह्म का सलोक, सार्ष्टि, सायुज्य पाते हैं

words.sanskrit: vishnum prathama-antyam mukham dvitiya-antyam bhadram tritiya-antyam aham chaturthy-antam

meaning.en: Vishnu ends the first, face the second, auspicious the third, I the fourth
meaning.hi: विष्णु पहले का, मुख दूसरे का, भद्र तीसरे का, अहं चौथे का अन्त्य अक्षर है

words.sanskrit: yatra kutra api mriyate dehante devah param brahma tarakam vyachashte

meaning.en: wherever one dies, at death this being reveals the crossing-over highest reality
meaning.hi: जहाँ भी मरे, मृत्यु में यह देव तारक परम ब्रह्म दिखाता है

words.sanskrit: y etam maha-upanishadam veda sa kritapurashcharano mahavishnur bhavati

meaning.en: whoever knows this great secret teaching, having done the preliminaries, becomes great Vishnu
meaning.hi: जो इस महोपनिषद को जानता है, वह महाविष्णु बन जाता है

words.sanskrit: deva ha vai mrityoh papmabhyah samsarach cha bibhiyuh

meaning.en: the gods feared death, sins, and rebirth
meaning.hi: देवता मृत्यु, पाप, संसार से डरे

words.sanskrit: te prajapatim upadhavan

meaning.en: they went to Prajapati
meaning.hi: वे प्रजापति के पास गए

words.sanskrit: tebhya etam mantra-rajam narasimham anushtubham prayacchat

meaning.en: he gave them this king of mantras, Narasimha in anushtubh
meaning.hi: उन्हें यह नरसिंह अनुष्टुभ मन्त्रराज दिया

words.sanskrit: purva matra prithivy-akarah sa rigbhir rigvedo brahma vasavo gayatri garhapatyah

meaning.en: the first unit is earth, shaped A, tied to Rig verses, Brahma, Vasus, Gayatri, household fire
meaning.hi: पहली इकाई पृथ्वी है, अ आकार, ऋक्, ब्रह्मा, वसु, गायत्री, गार्हपत्य से जुड़ी

words.sanskrit: dvitiya antariksham sa ukarah sa yajubhir yajurvedo vishnu-rudras trishtub dakshina-agnih

meaning.en: the second unit is atmosphere, shaped U, tied to Yajur verses, Vishnu-Rudra, Trishtubh, southern fire
meaning.hi: दूसरी इकाई अन्तरिक्ष है, उ आकार, यजुः, विष्णु-रुद्र, त्रिष्टुभ, दक्षिणाग्नि से जुड़ी

words.sanskrit: tritiya dyauh sa makarah sa samabhih samavedo rudra-adityah jagati ahavaniyah

meaning.en: the third unit is sky, shaped M, tied to Sama verses, Rudra-Adityas, Jagati, offering fire
meaning.hi: तीसरी इकाई द्यौ है, म आकार, साम, रुद्रादित्य, जगती, आहवनीय से जुड़ी

words.sanskrit: chaturthy-ardha-matra soma-loka omkarah

meaning.en: the fourth half-unit is the lunar realm, the syllable Om itself
meaning.hi: चौथी अर्ध-इकाई सोमलोक, स्वयं ॐकार है

words.sanskrit: ashtaksharah prathamah pado bhavati

meaning.en: the first quarter has eight syllables
meaning.hi: पहला चरण आठ अक्षरों का है

words.sanskrit: dvatrimshad-aksharani sampadyante

meaning.en: thirty-two syllables result in total
meaning.hi: कुल बत्तीस अक्षर बनते हैं

words.sanskrit: hridayaya namah shirase svaha shikhayai vashat kavachaya hum astraya phat

meaning.en: reverence to heart, hail to head, honor to crest, hum to armor, phat to weapon
meaning.hi: हृदय को नमः, सिर को स्वाहा, शिखा को वषट्, कवच को हुं, अस्त्र को फट्

words.sanskrit: vyatishikta va ime lokah tasmad vyatishiktani angani bhavanti

meaning.en: these worlds are interwoven, so the limbs are interwoven
meaning.hi: ये लोक गुँथे हैं, इसलिए अंग गुँथे हैं

words.sanskrit: om ity etad aksharam idam sarvam

meaning.en: Om, this syllable, is all this
meaning.hi: ॐ, यह अक्षर, यह सब है

words.sanskrit: ugram prathamam sthanam janiyat

meaning.en: fierce is the first station
meaning.hi: उग्र पहला स्थान है

words.sanskrit: viram dvitiyam sthanam mahavishnum tritiyam sthanam jvalantam chaturtham sthanam

meaning.en: heroic second, great Vishnu third, blazing fourth
meaning.hi: वीर दूसरा, महाविष्णु तीसरा, ज्वलन्त चौथा

words.sanskrit: sarvatomukham pancamam nrisimham shashtham bhishanam saptamam bhadram ashtamam

meaning.en: all-facing fifth, man-lion sixth, terrifying seventh, auspicious eighth
meaning.hi: सर्वतोमुख पाँचवाँ, नृसिंह छठा, भीषण सातवाँ, भद्र आठवाँ

words.sanskrit: mrityu-mrityum navamam namami dasamam aham ekadasham sthanam

meaning.en: death-to-death ninth, I-bow tenth, I-myself eleventh station
meaning.hi: मृत्युमृत्यु नवाँ, नमामि दसवाँ, अहं ग्यारहवाँ

words.sanskrit: ekadasha-pada va anushtub bhavati

meaning.en: the anushtubh has eleven parts
meaning.hi: अनुष्टुभ ग्यारह भागों की है

words.sanskrit: atha kasmad ucyata ugram iti

meaning.en: now why is he called the Fierce One
meaning.hi: अब उन्हें उग्र क्यों कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: svamahimna sarvan lokan sarvan devan udvrihnaty ajasram srijati visrijati

meaning.en: by his own greatness he lifts all worlds and gods, ceaselessly creating and releasing
meaning.hi: अपनी महिमा से वे सब लोकों और देवों को उठाते हैं, निरन्तर सृजन और विसर्जन करते हुए

words.sanskrit: stuhi shrutam gartasadam yuvanam mrigam na bhimam

meaning.en: praise the renowned one, seated in his lair, young yet fearsome like a wild beast
meaning.hi: विख्यात, माँद में बैठे, युवा फिर भी पशु-सा भयावह, की स्तुति करो

words.sanskrit: tasmad ucyata ugram iti

meaning.en: that is why he is called the Fierce One
meaning.hi: इसी से उन्हें उग्र कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: atha kasmad ucyate viram iti

meaning.en: now why is he called the Hero
meaning.hi: अब उन्हें वीर क्यों कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: sarvani bhutani viramati viramayati

meaning.en: he brings all beings to rest and settles them
meaning.hi: वे सारे प्राणियों को विश्राम दिलाते और शान्त करते हैं

words.sanskrit: yato virah karmanyah sudrikshah yuktagravah jayate devakamah

meaning.en: from him the capable, sharp-sighted hero is born, desired by the gods
meaning.hi: उनसे ही सक्षम, तीक्ष्ण-दृष्टि वीर जन्मता है, देवों द्वारा वांछित

words.sanskrit: tasmad ucyate viram iti

meaning.en: that is why he is called the Hero
meaning.hi: इसी से उन्हें वीर कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: atha kasmad ucyate mahavishnum iti

meaning.en: now why is he called the Great Vishnu
meaning.hi: अब उन्हें महाविष्णु क्यों कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: sarvani bhutani vyapnoti vyapayati

meaning.en: he pervades all beings and causes them to pervade
meaning.hi: वे सारे प्राणियों में व्याप्त होते और व्याप्त कराते हैं

words.sanskrit: sneho yatha pallala-pindam shantamulam otam protam

meaning.en: like oil soaking through a lump of ground sesame, woven through and through
meaning.hi: जैसे तेल तिल के ढेले में आर-पार बुना हुआ भीगता है

words.sanskrit: yasman na jatah paro anyo asti

meaning.en: no one else was ever born before him
meaning.hi: उनसे पहले कोई और न जन्मा

words.sanskrit: tasmad ucyate mahavishnum iti

meaning.en: that is why he is called the Great Vishnu
meaning.hi: इसी से उन्हें महाविष्णु कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: atha kasmad ucyate jvalantam iti

meaning.en: now why is he called the Blazing One
meaning.hi: अब उन्हें ज्वलन्त क्यों कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: svatejasa jvalati jvalayati jvalyate

meaning.en: he blazes with his own radiant heat and causes blazing
meaning.hi: वे अपने तेज से जलते हैं और जलाते हैं

words.sanskrit: savita prasavita dipto dipayan

meaning.en: the sun that impels, shining, causing to shine
meaning.hi: प्रेरक सूर्य, चमकता, चमकाता हुआ

words.sanskrit: tasmad ucyate jvalantam iti

meaning.en: that is why he is called the Blazing One
meaning.hi: इसी से उन्हें ज्वलन्त कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: atha kasmad ucyate sarvatomukham iti

meaning.en: now why is he called He Whose Face Is Everywhere
meaning.hi: अब उन्हें सर्वतोमुख क्यों कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: svayam anindriyo 'pi sarvatah pashyati sarvatah shrinoti

meaning.en: though without ordinary senses, he sees and hears in every direction
meaning.hi: साधारण इन्द्रियों के बिना भी वे हर दिशा में देखते और सुनते हैं

words.sanskrit: ekah purastad ya idam babhuva yato babhuva bhuvanasya gopah

meaning.en: he alone existed before this, the guardian of all that came to be
meaning.hi: वे अकेले इससे पहले थे, संसार के रक्षक

words.sanskrit: namami tam aham sarvatomukham

meaning.en: I bow to him whose face is everywhere
meaning.hi: मैं उन्हें नमन करता हूँ जिनका मुख हर ओर है

words.sanskrit: atha kasmad ucyate nrisimham iti

meaning.en: now why is he called the Man-Lion
meaning.hi: अब उन्हें नृसिंह क्यों कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: sarvesham bhutanam na viryatamah shreshthatamash cha simho viryatamah shreshthatamash cha

meaning.en: man is most capable among beings, lion most capable among animals
meaning.hi: मनुष्य प्राणियों में सबसे सक्षम, सिंह पशुओं में सबसे सक्षम है

words.sanskrit: tasman nrisimha asit parameshvarah jagaddhitam

meaning.en: so the highest lord became the man-lion, for the good of the world
meaning.hi: इसलिए सर्वोच्च ईश्वर नृसिंह बने, संसार के हित हेतु

words.sanskrit: yasya urushu trishu vikramaneshv adhikshiyanti bhuvanani vishva

meaning.en: in whose three strides all the worlds come to rest
meaning.hi: जिनके तीन डगों में सारे लोक विश्राम पाते हैं

words.sanskrit: tasmad ucyate nrisimham iti

meaning.en: that is why he is called the Man-Lion
meaning.hi: इसी से उन्हें नृसिंह कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: atha kasmad ucyate bhishanam iti

meaning.en: now why is he called the Terrifying One
meaning.hi: अब उन्हें भीषण क्यों कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: yasmad bhishanam yasya rupam drishtva sarve lokah palayante

meaning.en: at whose terrifying form all worlds flee in fear
meaning.hi: जिनके भीषण रूप को देखकर सारे लोक भाग जाते हैं

words.sanskrit: svayam yatah kutash cha na bibheti

meaning.en: he himself fears nothing from any quarter
meaning.hi: वे स्वयं किसी दिशा से नहीं डरते

words.sanskrit: bhishasmad vatah pavate bhishodeti suryah

meaning.en: out of fear of him the wind blows, the sun rises
meaning.hi: उनके भय से वायु बहती है, सूर्य उगता है

words.sanskrit: tasmad ucyate bhishanam iti

meaning.en: that is why he is called the Terrifying One
meaning.hi: इसी से उन्हें भीषण कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: atha kasmad ucyate bhadram iti

meaning.en: now why is he called the Gracious One
meaning.hi: अब उन्हें भद्र क्यों कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: yasmat svayam bhadro bhutva sarvada bhadram dadati

meaning.en: being gracious himself, he always grants grace
meaning.hi: स्वयं गुणकारी होकर वे सदा कृपा देते हैं

words.sanskrit: bhadram karnebhih shrinuyama devah bhadram pashyemakshabhir yajatrah

meaning.en: may we hear what is gracious, may we see what is gracious
meaning.hi: हम भद्र सुनें, हम भद्र देखें

words.sanskrit: tasmad ucyate bhadram iti

meaning.en: that is why he is called the Gracious One
meaning.hi: इसी से उन्हें भद्र कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: atha kasmad ucyate mrityumrityum iti

meaning.en: now why is he called Death of Death
meaning.hi: अब उन्हें मृत्युमृत्यु क्यों कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: yasmat svabhaktanam smrita eva mrityum apamrityum cha marayati

meaning.en: at the mere remembrance of his devotees, he destroys death and untimely death
meaning.hi: अपने भक्तों के स्मरण मात्र से वे मृत्यु और असमय मृत्यु को नष्ट करते हैं

words.sanskrit: ya atmada baladah yasya vishva upasate prashisham

meaning.en: giver of self, giver of strength, whose command all serve
meaning.hi: आत्मदाता, बलदाता, जिनकी आज्ञा सब मानते हैं

words.sanskrit: kasmai devaya havisha vidhema

meaning.en: with what offering shall we worship that god
meaning.hi: किस अर्पण से हम उस देवता की पूजा करें

words.sanskrit: tasmad ucyate mrityumrityum iti

meaning.en: that is why he is called Death of Death
meaning.hi: इसी से उन्हें मृत्युमृत्यु कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: atha kasmad ucyate namami iti

meaning.en: now why is he called I Bow
meaning.hi: अब उन्हें नमामि क्यों कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: yasmad yam sarve deva namanti mumukshavo brahmavadinash cha

meaning.en: whom all gods bow to, along with seekers of liberation and sages
meaning.hi: जिन्हें सब देवता, मोक्षार्थी और ब्रह्मवादी नमन करते हैं

words.sanskrit: yasmin indro varuno mitro aryama deva okamsi chakrire

meaning.en: in whom Indra, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, all gods have made their dwelling
meaning.hi: जिनमें इन्द्र, वरुण, मित्र, अर्यमा, सब देवों ने अपना निवास बनाया

words.sanskrit: tasmad ucyate namami iti

meaning.en: that is why he is called I Bow
meaning.hi: इसी से उन्हें नमामि कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: atha kasmad ucyate aham iti

meaning.en: now why is he called I
meaning.hi: अब उन्हें अहम् क्यों कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: aham asmi prathamaja ritasya purvam devebhyo amritasya nabhih

meaning.en: I am the firstborn of cosmic order, before the gods, the source of the immortal
meaning.hi: मैं ऋत का प्रथमजात हूँ, देवों से पहले, अमरता का स्रोत

words.sanskrit: aham annam annam adantam admi

meaning.en: I am food, and I eat the eater of food
meaning.hi: मैं अन्न हूँ, और अन्न खाने वाले को खाता हूँ

words.sanskrit: aham vishvam bhuvanam abhyabhavam suvarnajyotih

meaning.en: I have overcome this whole universe, radiant as gold
meaning.hi: मैंने यह सम्पूर्ण ब्रह्माण्ड जीत लिया, स्वर्ण-तेजस्वी

words.sanskrit: nanushtubhasya mantrarajasya narasimhasya shaktim bijam no bruhi bhagavan

meaning.en: tell us the power and seed of the man-lion mantra-king
meaning.hi: नृसिंह मन्त्रराज की शक्ति और बीज हमें बताइए

words.sanskrit: maya va esha narasimhi sarvam idam srijati sarvam idam rakshati sarvam idam samharati

meaning.en: this power is his creative force, which creates, protects, and gathers back all this
meaning.hi: यह शक्ति उनकी सृजनात्मक माया है, जो यह सब सृजती, रक्षती, और समेटती है

words.sanskrit: sa papmanam tarati sa mrityum tarati sa samsaram tarati so'mritatvam cha gacchati

meaning.en: he crosses wrongdoing, death, and the cycle of rebirth, and attains immortality
meaning.hi: वह पाप, मृत्यु, संसार-चक्र से पार जाता है और अमरत्व पाता है

words.sanskrit: mimamsante brahmavadino hrasva dirgha pluta cheti

meaning.en: the sages debate whether it is short, long, or drawn out
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मवादी बहस करते हैं कि यह ह्रस्व, दीर्घ, या प्लुत है

words.sanskrit: yadi hrasva bhavati sarvam papmanam dahaty amritatvam cha gacchati

meaning.en: if short, it burns away all wrongdoing and one attains immortality
meaning.hi: यदि ह्रस्व हो तो यह सारा पाप भस्म करता है और अमरत्व मिलता है

words.sanskrit: yadi dirgha bhavati mahatim shriyam apnoty amritatvam cha gacchati

meaning.en: if long, one gains great fortune and attains immortality
meaning.hi: यदि दीर्घ हो तो महान सम्पदा मिलती है और अमरत्व मिलता है

words.sanskrit: yadi pluta bhavati jnanavan bhavaty amritatvam cha gacchati

meaning.en: if drawn out, one becomes wise and attains immortality
meaning.hi: यदि प्लुत हो तो बुद्धिमत्ता मिलती है और अमरत्व मिलता है

words.sanskrit: sarveshim va etad bhutanam akashah parayanam

meaning.en: space is the final refuge of all these beings
meaning.hi: आकाश ही इन सब प्राणियों का अन्तिम शरण है

words.sanskrit: akashad eva jayante akashad jatani jivanti akasham prayanty abhisamvishanti

meaning.en: all beings are born from space, live by space, and settle back into space
meaning.hi: सब प्राणी आकाश से जन्मते, आकाश से जीते, और आकाश में विलीन होते हैं

words.sanskrit: tasmad akasham bijam vidyat tad eva jyayah

meaning.en: therefore know space as the seed; that indeed is superior
meaning.hi: इसलिए आकाश को बीज जानो; वही श्रेष्ठ है

words.sanskrit: nrishad varasad ritasad vyomasad abjago gojah

meaning.en: dwelling among men, in the finest offerings, in sacred law, in the sky; born of waters, born of cattle
meaning.hi: मनुष्यों में, उत्तम अर्पणों में, नियम में, आकाश में बसता; जल से, गौओं से जन्मा

words.sanskrit: ritajah adrijah ritam brihat

meaning.en: born of cosmic order, born of the mountain, he is cosmic order itself, vast
meaning.hi: ऋत से जन्मा, पर्वत से जन्मा, वह स्वयं ऋत है, विशाल

words.sanskrit: ya evam vedeti mahopanishat

meaning.en: for whoever knows this, this is a great secret teaching
meaning.hi: जो यह जानता है, यह उसके लिए महान गुप्त उपदेश है

words.sanskrit: anushtubhasya mantrarajasya narasimhasyangamantran no bruhi bhagava iti

meaning.en: tell us the auxiliary formulas of the man-lion mantra-king
meaning.hi: नृसिंह मन्त्रराज के सहायक सूत्र हमें बताइए

words.sanskrit: pranavam savitrim yajur lakshmim nrisimha-gayatrim ity angani janiyat

meaning.en: know the sacred syllable, Savitri, the fortune-hymn, and the man-lion hymn as its parts
meaning.hi: प्रणव, सावित्री, लक्ष्मी-स्तुति, और नृसिंह-स्तुति को इसके अंग जानो

words.sanskrit: yo janite so'mritatvam cha gacchati

meaning.en: whoever understands this attains immortality
meaning.hi: जो यह समझता है वह अमरत्व पाता है

words.sanskrit: om ity etad aksharam idam sarvam

meaning.en: this syllable Om is this entire universe
meaning.hi: यह अक्षर ॐ यह सम्पूर्ण ब्रह्माण्ड है

words.sanskrit: jagaritasthano bahih prajnah sthulabhug vaishvanarah prathamah padah

meaning.en: the waking state, aware outward, enjoying gross things, the universal one, first quarter
meaning.hi: जाग्रत अवस्था, बाहर सजग, स्थूल भोगी, वैश्वानर, पहला चरण

words.sanskrit: svapnasthane 'ntahprajnah praviviktabhuk taijaso dvitiyah padah

meaning.en: the dream state, aware within, enjoying subtle things, the brilliant one, second quarter
meaning.hi: स्वप्न अवस्था, भीतर सजग, सूक्ष्म भोगी, तैजस, दूसरा चरण

words.sanskrit: yatra supto na kanchana kamam kamayate na kanchana svapnam pashyati tat sushuptam

meaning.en: where the sleeper desires nothing and sees no dream, that is deep sleep
meaning.hi: जहाँ सोया हुआ न कुछ चाहता न स्वप्न देखता, वह सुषुप्ति है

words.sanskrit: prajnanaghana eva anandamayo hy anandabhuk prajnas tritiyah padah

meaning.en: an undivided mass of consciousness, made of bliss, the wise one, third quarter
meaning.hi: अखण्ड चेतना-पुंज, आनन्दमय, प्राज्ञ, तीसरा चरण

words.sanskrit: prapanchopashamam shantam shivam advaitam chaturtham manyante

meaning.en: the quieted, peaceful, auspicious, non-dual fourth is considered thus
meaning.hi: शान्त, शुभ, अद्वैत चौथे को ऐसा माना जाता है

words.sanskrit: atha savitri gayatrya yajusha prokta taya sarvam idam vyaptam

meaning.en: the Savitri hymn in gayatri metre pervades all this
meaning.hi: गायत्री में सावित्री स्तुति इस सब में व्याप्त है

words.sanskrit: ghrinir iti dve akshare surya iti trini etad vai savitrasyashtaksharam padam shriyabhishiktam

meaning.en: ghrini has two syllables, surya three, forming the eight-syllable fortune-crowned portion
meaning.hi: घृणि के दो अक्षर, सूर्य के तीन, आठ-अक्षर सम्पदा-मण्डित अंश बनाते हैं

words.sanskrit: om bhur lakshmir bhuvar lakshmih svar lakshmih kalakarni tan no mahalakshmih prachodayat

meaning.en: the great fortune-hymn invoking fortune of earth, atmosphere, and heaven
meaning.hi: पृथ्वी, अन्तरिक्ष, स्वर्ग की लक्ष्मी का आह्वान करने वाली महालक्ष्मी-स्तुति

words.sanskrit: om nrisimhaya vidmahe vajranakhaya dhimahi tan nah simhah prachodayat

meaning.en: the man-lion gayatri: may we know the man-lion of thunderbolt nails
meaning.hi: नृसिंह गायत्री: हम वज्रनख नृसिंह को जानें

words.sanskrit: atha kair mantraih stuto devah prito bhavati svatmanam darshayati

meaning.en: with which hymns of praise does the god become pleased and reveal himself
meaning.hi: किन स्तुतियों से देव प्रसन्न होकर स्वयं को प्रकट करते हैं

words.sanskrit: om yo ha vai nrisimho devo bhagavan yash cha brahma bhur bhuvah svas tasmai vai namo namah

meaning.en: salutation to the man-lion who is Brahma, earth, atmosphere, and heaven
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मा, पृथ्वी, अन्तरिक्ष, स्वर्ग रूप नृसिंह को नमस्कार

words.sanskrit: yatha prathamamantroktav adyantau tatha sarvamantreshu drashtavyau

meaning.en: as in the first hymn's beginning and end, so should it be seen in every hymn
meaning.hi: जैसे पहली स्तुति के आरम्भ और अन्त में, वैसे हर स्तुति में समझना चाहिए

words.sanskrit: yash cha vishnuh yash cha maheshvarah yash cha purushah yash cheshvarah

meaning.en: he who is Vishnu, he who is the great lord, he who is Person, he who is ruler
meaning.hi: जो विष्णु हैं, जो महेश्वर हैं, जो पुरुष हैं, जो ईश्वर हैं

words.sanskrit: ya sarasvati ya shrih ya gauri ya prakritih ya vidya

meaning.en: she who is speech-goddess, fortune, Gauri, nature, sacred wisdom
meaning.hi: जो सरस्वती हैं, जो लक्ष्मी हैं, जो गौरी हैं, जो प्रकृति हैं, जो विद्या हैं

words.sanskrit: yash chonkarah yash chatasro 'rdhamatrah ye vedah sangah sashakhah setihasah

meaning.en: he who is Om, the four quarter-syllables, the Vedas with branches and histories
meaning.hi: जो ॐ हैं, चार चतुर्थांश-अक्षर, शाखा-इतिहास सहित वेद

words.sanskrit: ye cha panchagnayah yah sapta mahavyahritayah ye chashtau lokapalah

meaning.en: the five sacred fires, the seven great utterances, the eight directional guardians
meaning.hi: पाँच अग्नियाँ, सात महाव्याहृतियाँ, आठ दिक्पाल

words.sanskrit: yash cha kalah yash cha manuh yash cha mrityuh yash cha yamah

meaning.en: he who is time, the first lawgiver, death, and the lord of death
meaning.hi: जो काल हैं, मनु हैं, मृत्यु हैं, यम हैं

words.sanskrit: yash cha jivah yach cha sarvam

meaning.en: he who is the individual self, and whatever else there is
meaning.hi: जो जीव हैं, और जो कुछ और है

words.sanskrit: iti dvatrimshat

meaning.en: this makes thirty-two in total
meaning.hi: यह कुल बत्तीस बनते हैं

words.sanskrit: etair mantrair nityam devam stuvadhvam

meaning.en: worship the god daily with these hymns
meaning.hi: इन स्तुतियों से प्रतिदिन देव की पूजा करो

words.sanskrit: tato devah prito bhavati svatmanam darshayati

meaning.en: then the god becomes pleased and reveals his own self
meaning.hi: तब देव प्रसन्न होकर स्वयं को प्रकट करते हैं

words.sanskrit: sa devam pashyati so'mritatvam cha gacchati

meaning.en: he sees the god and attains immortality
meaning.hi: वह देव को देखता है और अमरत्व पाता है

words.sanskrit: anushtubhasya mantrarajasya narasimhasya mahachakram nama chakram no bruhi

meaning.en: tell us the great mystical wheel called Mahachakra of the man-lion mantra-king
meaning.hi: नृसिंह मन्त्रराज के महाचक्र नामक चक्र को हमें बताइए

words.sanskrit: shadaksharam vai etat sudarshanam mahachakram tasmat shadaram bhavati shatpatram

meaning.en: this six-syllable Wheel of Fair Vision has six spokes and six petals
meaning.hi: यह छह-अक्षरी सुदर्शन महाचक्र छह अरों और छह पंखुड़ियों वाला है

words.sanskrit: madhye nabhir bhavati mayaya etat sarvam veshtitam bhavati natmanam maya sprishati

meaning.en: at the center is the hub, enclosed outside by maya, which never touches the self
meaning.hi: केन्द्र में नाभि है, बाहर से माया से घिरी, जो आत्मा को नहीं छूती

words.sanskrit: atha dvatrimshadaram dvatrimshatpatram chakram bhavati dvatrimshadaksharanushtub bhavati

meaning.en: then comes the thirty-two spoked, thirty-two petaled wheel of anushtubh
meaning.hi: फिर आता है बत्तीस अरों, बत्तीस पंखुड़ियों वाला अनुष्टुभ चक्र

words.sanskrit: etat sudarshanam mahachakram tasya madhye nabhyam tarakam yad aksharam narasimham ekaksharam tad bhavati

meaning.en: at the hub of this wheel sits the imperishable one-syllable seed of the man-lion
meaning.hi: इस चक्र की नाभि में नृसिंह का अक्षर बीज बैठा है

words.sanskrit: purastad vasava asate rudra dakshinata adityah pashchad vishvedevah uttarato brahmavishnumaheshvarah

meaning.en: to the east sit the bright ones, south the fierce ones, west universal gods, north the great trinity
meaning.hi: पूर्व में वसु, दक्षिण में रुद्र, पश्चिम में विश्वेदेव, उत्तर में त्रिमूर्ति

words.sanskrit: guruna labdham kanthe bahau shikhayam va badhnita

meaning.en: received from a teacher, it should be worn at throat, arm, or hair
meaning.hi: गुरु से प्राप्त होकर कण्ठ, भुजा, या केशों में धारण करना चाहिए

words.sanskrit: saptadvipavati bhumir dakshinartham navakalpate tasmach chhraddhaya yam kanchid gam dadyat sa dakshina bhavati

meaning.en: even the seven-continent earth is insufficient payment; a cow given in faith suffices
meaning.hi: सप्तद्वीप पृथ्वी भी पर्याप्त दक्षिणा नहीं; श्रद्धा से दी गाय ही पर्याप्त है

words.sanskrit: anushtubhasya mantrarajasya narasimhasya phalam no bruhi

meaning.en: tell us the fruit of the man-lion mantra-king
meaning.hi: नृसिंह मन्त्रराज का फल हमें बताइए

words.sanskrit: yo nityam adhite so'gniputo bhavati sa vayuputo bhavati sa adityaputo bhavati

meaning.en: whoever studies it daily is purified by fire, wind, and sun
meaning.hi: जो प्रतिदिन अध्ययन करता है वह अग्नि, वायु, सूर्य से शुद्ध होता है

words.sanskrit: sa sarvaputo bhavati sa sarvaputo bhavati

meaning.en: he becomes utterly purified, utterly purified
meaning.hi: वह पूरी तरह शुद्ध हो जाता है, पूरी तरह शुद्ध हो जाता है

words.sanskrit: sa mrityum tarati sa papmanam tarati sa bhrunahatyam tarati sa virahatyam tarati

meaning.en: he crosses beyond death, sin, the sin of killing the unborn, killing a hero
meaning.hi: वह मृत्यु, पाप, भ्रूण-हत्या, वीर-हत्या से पार जाता है

words.sanskrit: sa sarvahatyam tarati sa samsaram tarati

meaning.en: he crosses beyond every grave wrongdoing and the cycle of rebirth
meaning.hi: वह हर गम्भीर पाप और संसार-चक्र से पार जाता है

words.sanskrit: sa sarvam tarati sa sarvam tarati

meaning.en: he crosses beyond everything whatsoever, everything whatsoever
meaning.hi: वह बिल्कुल सब कुछ से पार जाता है, सब कुछ से पार जाता है

words.sanskrit: so'gnim stambhayati sa vayum stambhayati sa adityam stambhayati

meaning.en: he gains mastery over fire, wind, and the sun
meaning.hi: वह अग्नि, वायु, सूर्य पर नियन्त्रण पाता है

words.sanskrit: sa visham stambhayati sa visham stambhayati

meaning.en: he gains mastery over poison, over poison
meaning.hi: वह विष पर नियन्त्रण पाता है, विष पर नियन्त्रण पाता है

words.sanskrit: sa devan akarshayati sa yakshan akarshayati sa naganakarshayati

meaning.en: he draws gods, celestial musicians, and serpent spirits toward himself
meaning.hi: वह देवों, यक्षों, नागों को अपनी ओर खींचता है

words.sanskrit: sa manushyan akarshayati sa sarvan akarshayati sa sarvan akarshayati

meaning.en: he draws humans, draws everyone, draws everyone
meaning.hi: वह मनुष्यों को, सबको, सबको अपनी ओर खींचता है

words.sanskrit: sa bhurlokam jayati sa bhuvarlokam jayati sa svarlokam jayati

meaning.en: he conquers the earthly, atmospheric, and heavenly realms
meaning.hi: वह भूलोक, भुवर्लोक, स्वर्लोक जीतता है

words.sanskrit: sa satyalokam jayati sa sarvamllokan jayati sa sarvamllokan jayati

meaning.en: he conquers the realm of truth and every realm whatsoever
meaning.hi: वह सत्यलोक और हर लोक जीतता है

words.sanskrit: so'gnishtomena yajate sa ukthyena yajate sa shodashina yajate

meaning.en: he worships through the agnishtoma, ukthya, and shodashi sacrifices
meaning.hi: वह अग्निष्टोम, उक्थ्य, षोडशी यज्ञ से पूजा करता है

words.sanskrit: so'shvamedhena yajate sa sarvaih kratubhir yajate sa sarvaih kratubhir yajate

meaning.en: he worships through the horse sacrifice, through every sacred rite
meaning.hi: वह अश्वमेध से, हर पवित्र अनुष्ठान से पूजा करता है

words.sanskrit: sa richo'dhite sa yajumshy adhite sa samany adhite

meaning.en: he studies the sacrificial verses, formulas, and chants
meaning.hi: वह ऋचाओं, यजुष, सामों का अध्ययन करता है

words.sanskrit: sa pranavam adhite yah pranavam adhite sa sarvam adhite sa sarvam adhite

meaning.en: he studies the sacred syllable; whoever studies it studies everything
meaning.hi: वह प्रणव का अध्ययन करता है; जो इसका अध्ययन करता है वह सब कुछ पढ़ता है

words.sanskrit: anupanita-shatam ekam ekenopanitena tat samam

meaning.en: a hundred unordained boys equal one ordained boy
meaning.hi: सौ अनुपनीत बालक एक उपनीत के बराबर

words.sanskrit: yatinam tu shatam purnam ekena rudrajapakena tat samam

meaning.en: a hundred renunciates equal one reciter of Rudra's hymn
meaning.hi: सौ यति एक रुद्र-जपक के बराबर

words.sanskrit: yatra na suryas tapati yatra na vayur vati

meaning.en: where the sun does not scorch, where the wind does not blow
meaning.hi: जहाँ सूर्य नहीं जलाता, जहाँ वायु नहीं बहती

words.sanskrit: sadanandam paramanandam shantam shashvatam sadashivam

meaning.en: constant bliss, supreme bliss, peaceful, eternal, ever auspicious
meaning.hi: निरन्तर आनन्द, परमानन्द, शान्त, शाश्वत, सदाशिव

words.sanskrit: tad vishnoh paramam padam sada pashyanti surayah divi iva chakshur atatam

meaning.en: the wise always behold Vishnu's highest abode, like an eye beholding the sky
meaning.hi: बुद्धिमान सदा विष्णु के परम पद को देखते हैं, जैसे आँख आकाश को देखती है

words.sanskrit: tad vipraso vipanyavo jagrivamsah samindhate vishnor yat paramam padam

meaning.en: the watchful, ever-kindling wise ones know Vishnu's highest abode
meaning.hi: जागरूक, सदा प्रज्वलित बुद्धिमान विष्णु के परम पद को जानते हैं

words.sanskrit: tad etan nishkamasya bhavati tad etan nishkamasya bhavati

meaning.en: this belongs to one free of desire, free of desire
meaning.hi: यह इच्छारहित का है, इच्छारहित का है

words.sanskrit: nrisimhottaratapinyam turyaturyatmakam mahah

meaning.en: in the later man-lion Tapaniya section, the radiance of the fourth beyond the fourth
meaning.hi: उत्तर नृसिंहतापनी में, तुर्यातुर्य का तेज

words.sanskrit: paramadvaitasamrajyam pratyaksham upalabhyate

meaning.en: the supreme non-dual sovereignty is directly experienced
meaning.hi: परम अद्वैत साम्राज्य प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव में आता है

words.sanskrit: anor aniyamsam imam atmanam onkaram no vyachakshva iti

meaning.en: explain to us this self, the syllable Om, subtler than the subtlest
meaning.hi: हमें यह आत्मा, ॐ, सूक्ष्मतम से सूक्ष्म, समझाइए

words.sanskrit: sarvam hy etad brahma ayam atma brahma

meaning.en: all this indeed is Brahman; this self is Brahman
meaning.hi: यह सब ब्रह्म है; यह आत्मा ब्रह्म है

words.sanskrit: tad ekam ajaram amritam abhayam om ity anubhuya

meaning.en: experiencing that one as unaging, immortal, fearless, through Om
meaning.hi: उस एक को अजर, अमर, निर्भय, ॐ से अनुभव करते हुए

words.sanskrit: vishvo vaishvanarah prathamah padah

meaning.en: the universal one, first quarter
meaning.hi: विश्व वैश्वानर, पहला चरण

words.sanskrit: svapnasthanah sukshmaprajnah saptanga ekonavimshatimukhah

meaning.en: the dream state, aware of subtle things, seven limbs, nineteen channels
meaning.hi: स्वप्न-अवस्था, सूक्ष्म सजग, सात अंग, उन्नीस मुख

words.sanskrit: sukshmabhuk chaturatma taijaso hiranyagarbho dvitiyah padah

meaning.en: enjoying subtle things, fourfold, the brilliant one, second quarter
meaning.hi: सूक्ष्म भोगी, चतुरात्मा, तैजस, दूसरा चरण

words.sanskrit: yatra supto na kanchana kamam kamayate na kanchana svapnam pashyati tat sushuptam

meaning.en: where the sleeper desires nothing and sees no dream, that is deep sleep
meaning.hi: जहाँ सोया न कुछ चाहे न स्वप्न देखे, वह सुषुप्ति है

words.sanskrit: prajnas tritiyah padah sarveshvarah

meaning.en: the wise one, the third quarter, is the Lord of all
meaning.hi: प्राज्ञ, तीसरा चरण, सबका ईश्वर है

words.sanskrit: esha sarveshvara esha sarvajna eshontaryami esha yonih sarvasya prabhavapyayau

meaning.en: this is the ruler of all, knower of all, inner controller, source and dissolution of all
meaning.hi: यह सबका शासक, ज्ञाता, अन्तर्यामी, सबका उद्गम और विलय है

words.sanskrit: trayam apy etat sushuptam svapnam mayamatram chidekaraso hy ayam atma

meaning.en: all three states are like deep sleep, dream, mere illusion from the fourth's view
meaning.hi: तीनों अवस्थाएँ चौथे के दृष्टिकोण से गहरी निद्रा, स्वप्न, माया जैसी हैं

words.sanskrit: prapanchopashamam shantam shivam advaitam chaturtham manyante

meaning.en: the quieted, peaceful, auspicious, non-dual is considered the fourth
meaning.hi: शान्त, शुभ, अद्वैत को चौथा माना जाता है

words.sanskrit: chakshusho drashta shrotrasya drashta vacho drashta manaso drashta buddher drashta

meaning.en: the seer behind the eye, hearer behind the ear, speaker behind speech, thinker behind mind
meaning.hi: आँख के पीछे द्रष्टा, कान के पीछे श्रोता, वाणी के पीछे वक्ता, मन के पीछे चिन्तक

words.sanskrit: sarvasya sakshi tato'nyo vilakshanah

meaning.en: witness of everything, distinct and beyond all it witnesses
meaning.hi: सबका साक्षी, हर उस चीज़ से भिन्न और परे जिसका वह साक्षी है

words.sanskrit: ajaram amritam abhayam brahmaivapy ajam enam

meaning.en: unaging, immortal, fearless, Brahman itself, unborn
meaning.hi: अजर, अमर, निर्भय, स्वयं ब्रह्म, अजन्मा

words.sanskrit: svapnasthanash chaturatma taijaso hiranyagarbhash chaturupa ukara eva

meaning.en: the dream state, fourfold, the brilliant one, is fourfold, the letter U itself
meaning.hi: स्वप्न-अवस्था, चतुर्विध, तैजस, चतुर्विध उकार अक्षर है

words.sanskrit: utkarshad ubhayatvat sthulatvat sukshmatvad bijatvat sakshitvach chotkarshati

meaning.en: through rising, being between both, grossness, subtlety, seed, witness, it rises
meaning.hi: उठने, दोनों के बीच होने, स्थूलता, सूक्ष्मता, बीज, साक्षी से यह उठता है

words.sanskrit: sushuptasthanash chaturatma prajna ishvarash chaturupo makara eva

meaning.en: deep sleep, fourfold, the wise Lord, is fourfold, the letter M itself
meaning.hi: गहरी निद्रा, चतुर्विध, प्राज्ञ ईश्वर, चतुर्विध मकार है

words.sanskrit: miter apiter va sthulatvat sukshmatvad bijatvat sakshitvach cha minoti

meaning.en: through measuring or dissolving, grossness, subtlety, seed, witness, it measures all
meaning.hi: मापने या विलीन होने से, स्थूलता, सूक्ष्मता, बीज, साक्षी से यह सब मापता है

words.sanskrit: atha esha uga eva aksharam idam sarvam

meaning.en: this letter A is this entire universe
meaning.hi: यह अक्षर अ यह सम्पूर्ण ब्रह्माण्ड है

words.sanskrit: prapanchopashamah shivo'dvaita onkara atmaiva samvishaty atmanatmanam ya evam veda

meaning.en: the quieting of distinction, auspicious, non-dual, self enters self through Om, for whoever knows this
meaning.hi: भेद का शान्त होना, शुभ, अद्वैत, आत्मा ॐ से आत्मा में प्रवेश करती है, जो यह जानता है उसके लिए

words.sanskrit: esha viro narasimha eveti

meaning.en: this hero is truly the man-lion himself
meaning.hi: यह वीर सचमुच स्वयं नृसिंह है

words.sanskrit: tasya ha vai pranavasya ya purva matra sa prathamah pado bhavati

meaning.en: the first quarter-syllable of Om forms the first quarter of the self
meaning.hi: ॐ का पहला चतुर्थांश-अक्षर आत्मा का पहला चरण बनाता है

words.sanskrit: prithivyakarah sa rigbhir rigvedo brahma vasavo gayatri garhapatyah sa prathamah padah

meaning.en: earth, the letter A, linked to Rigveda, Brahma, the bright ones, gayatri, household fire
meaning.hi: पृथ्वी, अक्षर अ, ऋग्वेद, ब्रह्मा, वसु, गायत्री, गार्हपत्य अग्नि से जुड़ा

words.sanskrit: sa mukto bhavati sa svarad bhavati ya evam veda

meaning.en: he becomes free, he becomes self-ruling, whoever knows this
meaning.hi: वह मुक्त हो जाता है, स्वराट बन जाता है, जो यह जानता है

words.sanskrit: tam va etam atmanam param brahma onkaram turiyonkaragravidyotam anushtubha natva

meaning.en: bowing with anushtubh to this self, highest Brahman, Om, the fourth beyond the fourth
meaning.hi: अनुष्टुभ से इस आत्मा, ब्रह्म, ॐ, चौथे से परे चौथे को नमन करके

words.sanskrit: esha eva nrisimho'sau parameshvaro'sau

meaning.en: he alone is the man-lion, the highest lord
meaning.hi: वही अकेला नृसिंह है, सर्वोच्च ईश्वर

words.sanskrit: esha eva ugra esha eva vira esha eva mahan esha evaham

meaning.en: he alone is fierce, hero, great, I myself
meaning.hi: वही अकेला उग्र, वीर, महान, मैं स्वयं है

words.sanskrit: samstabhya simham svasutan gunarthan

meaning.en: having restrained the lion, having united his sons with their purpose
meaning.hi: सिंह को रोककर, पुत्रों को उद्देश्य से जोड़कर

words.sanskrit: samyojya shringair rishabhasya hatva

meaning.en: having struck down with the horns of a bull
meaning.hi: वृषभ के सींगों से मार गिराकर

words.sanskrit: vashyam sphurantim asatim nipidya

meaning.en: having overpowered and pressed down the unruly, flickering one
meaning.hi: अनियन्त्रित, चंचल को दबाकर

words.sanskrit: sambhakshya simhena sa esha virah

meaning.en: having devoured it as a lion, he, this hero
meaning.hi: सिंह के रूप में भक्षण करके, यह वीर

words.sanskrit: shringaprotan padan sprishtva hatva tan agrasat svayam

meaning.en: having touched the horn-pierced feet, having struck them down, he swallowed them himself
meaning.hi: सींग से बिँधे पैरों को छूकर, मार गिराकर, उसने स्वयं निगल लिया

words.sanskrit: natva cha bahudha drishtva nrisimhah svayam udbabhau iti

meaning.en: having bowed and beheld many forms, the man-lion himself rose up
meaning.hi: नमन करके कई रूप देखकर, स्वयं नृसिंह उठ खड़े हुए

words.sanskrit: atha esha u eva akara aptatama artha atmanyeva nrisimhe deve brahmani vartate

meaning.en: this letter A truly exists as the highest reality within the self, the man-lion, Brahman
meaning.hi: यह अक्षर अ सचमुच आत्मा में सर्वोच्च सत्य है, नृसिंह, ब्रह्म

words.sanskrit: atmaiva nrisimho devo brahma bhavati ya evam veda

meaning.en: the self alone becomes the man-lion, God, Brahman, for whoever knows this
meaning.hi: अकेली आत्मा नृसिंह, ईश्वर, ब्रह्म बन जाती है, जो यह जानता है

words.sanskrit: so'kamo nishkama aptakama atmakamena tasya prana utkramanty atraiva samavaliyante brahmaiva san brahmapyeti

meaning.en: free of desire, his breaths do not depart but are absorbed into Brahman, becoming Brahman
meaning.hi: इच्छारहित, उसके प्राण विदा नहीं होते, ब्रह्म में समा जाते हैं, ब्रह्म बनते हुए

words.sanskrit: te deva imam atmanam jnatum aichchhams tan hasurah papma parijagraha

meaning.en: the gods wished to know this self; a demonic wrongdoing seized them
meaning.hi: देवता इस आत्मा को जानना चाहते थे; आसुरी पाप ने उन्हें जकड़ा

words.sanskrit: ugram anugram viram aviram mahantam amahantam nrisimham anrisimham

meaning.en: fierce yet not fierce, heroic yet not heroic, great yet not great, man-lion yet not man-lion
meaning.hi: उग्र फिर भी अनुग्र, वीर फिर भी अवीर, महान फिर भी अमहान, नृसिंह फिर भी अनृसिंह

words.sanskrit: tebhyo hasav asurah papma sachchidanandaghanajyotir abhavat

meaning.en: from them, that demonic wrongdoing became a mass of light of existence, consciousness, bliss
meaning.hi: उनसे वह आसुरी पाप सत्-चित्-आनन्द के प्रकाश-पुंज में बदल गया

words.sanskrit: andha badhira mugdhah klibah muka unmatta iva parivartamanah shanta danta uparatas titikshavah

meaning.en: appearing blind, deaf, bewildered, mute, as though maddened, peaceful, self-controlled, patient
meaning.hi: अन्धे, बहरे, भ्रमित, मूक, मानो पागल, शान्त, आत्मसंयमित, धैर्यवान दिखते हुए

words.sanskrit: shringena shringam samyojya simham shringeshu yojayet

meaning.en: having joined horn to horn, one should set the lion between the horns
meaning.hi: सींग को सींग से जोड़कर, सिंह को सींगों के बीच रखना चाहिए

words.sanskrit: shringabhyam shringam abaddhya trayo deva upasata iti

meaning.en: having bound horn with horns, three gods are thus worshipped
meaning.hi: सींगों से सींग बाँधकर, तीन देवता इस तरह पूजे जाते हैं

words.sanskrit: bhuya eva no bhagavan vijnapayatv iti

meaning.en: instruct us further, lord, in this teaching
meaning.hi: हे भगवन्, हमें इसमें आगे सिखाइए

words.sanskrit: ajatvad amaratvad ajaratvad amritatvad ashokatvad amohatvad advaitatvach chakarenemam atmanam anvishya

meaning.en: through unaging, deathless, sorrowless, non-dual qualities, search this self through the letter A
meaning.hi: अजन्मा, अमर, दुःखरहित, अद्वैत गुणों से, अक्षर अ से आत्मा खोजें

words.sanskrit: kas tvam ity aham iti hovachaivam evedam sarvam tasmad aham iti sarvabhidhanam

meaning.en: who are you, I am he answered; thus all this is so, and I is the name for everything
meaning.hi: तुम कौन हो, मैं हूँ उत्तर दिया; इस तरह यह सब है, मैं सब कुछ का नाम है

words.sanskrit: avachanenaivanubhavann uvacha

meaning.en: he spoke only through direct experience, never through mere words
meaning.hi: उन्होंने केवल प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव से कहा, कभी बस शब्दों से नहीं

words.sanskrit: shringam shringardham akrishya shringenanena yojayet

meaning.en: having drawn out one horn by its half-horn, join it with this horn
meaning.hi: एक सींग को उसके आधे सींग से निकालकर, इस सींग से जोड़ें

words.sanskrit: shringam enam pare shringe tam anenapi yojayet

meaning.en: join this horn to the far horn, unite it with that one too
meaning.hi: इस सींग को दूर के सींग से जोड़ें, उससे भी एकीकृत करें

words.sanskrit: atha turiyenotash cha protash cha hy ayam atma nrisimho'smin sarvamayam sarvatmanam

meaning.en: through the fourth, this self, the man-lion, is woven and connecting, pervading all
meaning.hi: चौथे से, यह आत्मा, नृसिंह, बुनी और जोड़ती हुई, सब में व्याप्त

words.sanskrit: vag va onkaro vagevedam sarvam

meaning.en: speech itself is the sacred syllable; speech alone is all this
meaning.hi: वाणी स्वयं ॐ है; अकेली वाणी यह सब है

words.sanskrit: etad amritam etad brahmabhayam vai brahma bhavati ya evam vedeti rahasyam

meaning.en: this becomes the immortal, fearless Brahman, for whoever knows this; this is the secret
meaning.hi: यह अमर, निर्भय ब्रह्म बनता है, जो यह जानता है उसके लिए; यह रहस्य है

words.sanskrit: shatadha sahasradha bhinno mrityoh sa mrityum apnoti

meaning.en: one who imagines it shattered a hundred or thousand ways meets death after death
meaning.hi: जो इसे सौ या हज़ार टुकड़ों में बिखरा मानता है उसे बार-बार मृत्यु मिलती है

words.sanskrit: esha atma nrisimhash chidrupa evavikaro hy upalabdhah sarvasya sarvatra

meaning.en: this self, the man-lion, is pure consciousness, unchanging, perceived by all everywhere
meaning.hi: यह आत्मा, नृसिंह, शुद्ध चेतना है, अपरिवर्तित, सबके द्वारा हर जगह अनुभव की गई

words.sanskrit: tad yatha vatabijasamanyam ekam anekan svavyatiriktan vatan sabijan utpadya tatra tatra purnam sattishthati

meaning.en: like a banyan seed's shared nature producing many banyan trees, each not separate from it
meaning.hi: जैसे बरगद के बीज का साझा स्वभाव कई बरगद उत्पन्न करता है, हर एक उससे अलग नहीं

words.sanskrit: evam eva esha maya svavyatiriktani purnani kshetrani darshayitva jiveshavabhasena karoti

meaning.en: this creative power displays fields not separate from the self, appearing as soul and lord
meaning.hi: यह सृजनात्मक शक्ति आत्मा से अलग न होने वाले क्षेत्र दिखाती है, जीव और ईश्वर के रूप में प्रकट होकर

words.sanskrit: tasmad advaya evayam atma sanmatro nityah shuddho buddhah satyo muktah

meaning.en: this self alone is non-dual, purely existent, eternal, pure, awake, true, free
meaning.hi: अकेली यह आत्मा अद्वैत है, विशुद्ध विद्यमान, शाश्वत, शुद्ध, जागृत, सच्ची, मुक्त

words.sanskrit: otam otena janiyad anujnataram antaram

meaning.en: know the inner controller through the state of being woven through
meaning.hi: बुने जाने की अवस्था से अन्तर्यामी को जानो

words.sanskrit: anujnam advayam labdhva upadrashtaram avrajet

meaning.en: having attained non-dual permission, proceed toward the witness beyond
meaning.hi: अद्वैत अनुमति पाकर, परे के साक्षी की ओर बढ़ो
